description: Make an AI Story Video (a faceless narrated short in the chosen format: what if, scary story, history, body facts, choose your path, cartoon story...). It spends credits from the user's MakeViral account (a part that fails gives its credits back) and takes several minutes: this call returns at once, then call get_story_video with wait true. Two ways: 1) your own script as `draft` (written with story_video_guide's prompts; MakeViral then only makes the video and charges no writer), or 2) only the `idea` (and the user's own `story`, if any), and MakeViral writes the script. Before calling: check it with check_story_video and tell the user the price in credits. Calling again with the same input within 10 minutes returns the first story.

continueFrom.description: Part 2 of a finished choose-your-path (or 'Part 2?') story of this user

choice.description: The option the viewers voted for (0-based)

draft.description: Your own script: the JSON the writer prompt of story_video_guide asks for (title, characters, places, scenes, choices, stats...).

format.description: The video format. Default what-if. story_video_guide lists them with examples.

idea.description: One line, e.g. 'What if the moon disappeared?'

quality.description: How many scenes move (AI clips) instead of stills. Default: the format's.

requestId.description: Optional id (8-64 letters, digits, - or _). The same id never charges twice.

seconds.description: Length in seconds. Default: the format's.

story.description: The user's own full story, when there is one: the script keeps its events, names and facts

voiceId.description: Narrator voice id (story_video_guide). Default: the format's.

name: start_story_video
title: Make a faceless story video
